title: PAH-OMC-020 deterministic correlation modulus
question: Do the pinned R-511 form-energy bounds yield a deterministic-time compact correlation modulus uniformly over the retained finite indices, without importing a pointwise rate bound or taking the anchored-n limit?
finding: Yes, conditionally at the finite form-energy level. For every fixed stabilized local pair f,g, the unchanged R-511 bound B_f=2 D_f M_f^2+2 H_f L_f^2 and finite reversible spectral calculus give |C_(n,j)(f,g;t)-C_(n,j)(f,g;s)| <= |t-s| sqrt(B_f B_g), uniformly in retained finite n,j. This is deterministic external Markov time only; it does not imply the bounded-stopping-time Aldous estimate, path-space tightness, or R-512 target identification.
